I wrote `{"invariant_exists": true}` to the answer file. I worked this out by reading the code only; nothing was run.

**Why the path is the same every time:** in `_walk` (`src/cfnlint/template/transforms/_language_extensions.py:111-198`), the random 7-letter value is only used as text and as a parameter value. None of the branches check it.
- **Key rename (lines 115-120):** `Bucket${L}` always becomes a different key, so `new_k != k` comes out true on every run.
- **Branch checks (lines 124 and 141-185):** `Bucket<random>` never matches the ForEach pattern or any of the fixed names (`Fn::ToJsonString`, `Fn::GetAtt`, `Fn::Sub`, `Fn::FindInMap`, `Ref`). It always drops through to the plain `else` at line 185.
- **Duplicate check (line 133):** the two random names are always new keys, so the duplicate error never fires.
- **Start state:** each test creates a fresh `_Transform()`, so there's no cache left over from an earlier run.

**One caveat:** if the two random values ever came out the same (odds about 1 in 52^7), line 136 would raise the duplicate error and the path would change. I treated that as negligible.
